args.body: Advance existing NOV17-TENDER-OBSERVATION-DECISION using actual UTC time and valid ownership. At or after November 17 09:00 UTC, read prepared-decision.json and then-current permitted aggregate observations, save/read the final continue/change/stop decision and close with your actual lease and a lesson. Before that time, do not finalize or poll repeatedly. Missing classification coverage means UNKNOWN requests, not zero demand; distinguish requests, delivery, orders and settled revenue. Reuse verified supersession evidence and preserve December/January expiry duties plus welfare retirement December 4 17:00 UTC. Do not retire under superseded November instructions. No new inventory, repeated tests or publication from a provider ineligible under the host independence gate.

description: Five unclassified sources and ten unexplained skips leave demand unknown. The tender observation deadline is the next decision point; its superseded retirement instructions must not trigger an early shutdown.
